description: This file defines a Perl module 'Git::IndexInfo' that manages interactions with the Git index, including creating, removing entries, and updating index information. It uses external Git functions and handles index piping commands.

classes.name: Git::IndexInfo
classes.description: A Perl class for managing Git index information, including adding, removing, and updating index entries.

methods.name: new
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the index info object, determines hash algorithm, and opens an index pipe.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes an index entry for the specified file path from the index pipe.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates the index with a new mode, hash, and path information.

methods.name: DESTROY
methods.description: Destructor that closes the index pipe.
